name: Sour bamboo with egg
summary: Muong sour bamboo stir-fried with egg, at bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, uses sour măng bương. Lift it from the jar, cover it with plain water, and boil about 15 minutes. Fry garlic, then stir-fry the bamboo. Add duck or chicken egg for about 5 minutes. The seasoning line is garlic, mắc khén, dried chili, salt, and mì chính.
origin: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019.
howToEat: From the pan. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. A city shop was not named.
